title: Prove coordinate charts suffice for coordinate-terminal cache trees (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped all-field proof with exact finite corroboration. For a typed-copy cache tree whose terminals are coordinate Lagrangian charts in one common symplectic basis, arbitrary intermediate charts cannot lower its rank-only cost.

```text
L_v -> echelon pivots in self-dual coordinate order -> R(L_v)
terminals fixed; d(R(L),R(M)) <= d(L,M)
any nondecreasing paid edge tariff therefore cannot increase
```

Every variable vertex can be restricted to 2^n coordinate charts. This holds for arbitrary finite trees and includes the power tariff r^(1-kappa). No new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit zxv's PR5283 for the snapshot-tree contract and paid Lagrangian metric, Matarener's PR5060, Dugongue's PR4534 and the retained native/helper/compiler/supplier lineage. Elementary pivot and initial-subspace facts are background; no literature-priority claim is intended. The predecessor constructions and counts are cited rather than replayed or audited.

## Evidence

Before, the cited cache model permits arbitrary intermediate Lagrangians. After, the explicit retraction fixes all common-coordinate terminals and contracts every edge distance. The written proof supplies the universal quantifiers.

The standalone checker enumerates 2,379 row-reduced planes in seven small-field domains, retains 359 charts, and checks all 44,447 ordered pairs using literal vector-set intersections independently of the pivot calculation. It records 37,780 strict contractions and 416 monotone tariff/distance checks. Another 675 labeled trees cover three fixed four-terminal topologies; restricted and unrestricted minima agree at 3,3,7/2 under prices (0,1,3/2). Seven malformed-chart rejections and four scope controls pass.

Locally on CPython 3.12.15, warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass in 0.067 and 0.065 seconds respectively. These are timeout measurements, not a runtime improvement claim. Registered metadata/replay, tabnanny, function-length bounds, whitespace, exact committed bytes and source ancestry all pass. The official committed export passes integrity checking, and both direct modes pass from its read-only Git-free extraction with empty PATH and all seven exported files unchanged. The generated stdout receipt binds all six package files by SHA256.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/coordinate-cache-retraction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/coordinate-cache-retraction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coordinate-cache-retraction
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/coordinate-cache-retraction --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_COORDINATE_CACHE_RETRACTION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Standard library only; replay writes nothing. Add `--emit-result` to the direct command for its generated hash-bound receipt.

## Limitations

Every terminal must use one common coordinate basis. Negative internal-edge credits, decreasing prices and unproved intermediate feasibility constraints are outside the reduction. The theorem prices rank-dependent edges only. It does not supply a source-bound current caller, ordinary monomial costs, absolute phases, native realization, ownership, dirty restoration, snapshot lifetimes, precision/tape bounds or a complete signed invoice. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Ruff is unavailable locally; warning-strict interpreter checks and tabnanny pass.

## Open next questions

Find one actual repeated source snapshot whose required read charts share a coordinate basis. Pin its exact operator row and lifetime, then price one complete retracted tree including ordinary work and restoration. The physical consumer and complete costs remain blockers; no follow-on search is reserved.

## Related open work

No open PR for this coordinate-terminal cache-tree reduction was found in the complete 310-PR overlap snapshot, supplemented by the refreshed latest 100 open PRs and current claims. Coverage excludes unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs.

- #4993 explores joint frame retiming after carried swaps. Its changed word and boundary costs differ from this rank-only cache-tree restriction; no numerical comparison is claimed.
- #6194 constructs strict local traps for rank-one projection optimization. This gives a simultaneous global search restriction for common-coordinate Lagrangian terminals, rather than a statement about improving local moves.

- #6192 bounds odd-cyclotomic whole-bank Clifford responses using Pauli symplectic defect and native B rank. Those are different quantities from this cache-tree edge distance; no common numerical result is compared.

Completion refresh inspected all twelve other account PRs still open and created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-29T16:22:26Z. Apart from the adjacent #6192 and #6194 described above, they concern cyclic reversal boundary ranks, coefficient recovery, XOR snapshot scheduling, source-specific P104 birth costs, E8 spans, draft/export/replay performance, cubic readers and ordered-shear primes. None studies this coordinate-terminal cache-tree minimum or reports a conflicting same-instance number. No extra computations were run to validate another submission.

Related merged PR4866 gives a separate three-contact rule over all subspaces and explicitly excludes Lagrangian transfer. This theorem concerns any finite tree with common-coordinate Lagrangian terminals. Canonical main was refreshed before claiming and committing and remains a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7. Sparse local-note coverage was incomplete; distinctive main README/formula searches and all-state/merged PR searches supplemented it.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Six new files in one scoped research directory. Shared implementations, frozen evidence and the selected record are unchanged.
